facts_before_completion.access_control: Hard admin allowlist on UI and API.
facts_before_completion.storage: Source result cache only; no normalized fitment/evidence tables.
facts_before_completion.execution: Synchronous lookup for one exact branded article.
facts_before_completion.exports: Standalone XLSX for one exact branded article.

verified_constraints: Applicability must stay attached to the exact branded article.
Cross numbers cannot inherit applicability automatically.
Unknown period endpoints cannot be converted to open production.
The pilot must remain unavailable to every tenant except admin.
unknowns_at_baseline: Direct fitment availability in HOLA, METACO, LYNXauto and FEBEST.
Observed batch timing and cache-hit rate after production use.
Commercial quality threshold outside the admin pilot.
